sources.label: 令和7年度定例会2月議会 議案等

name: 聴聞などの通知をネットでも公示
summary: 現在、公示による聴聞や弁明の機会の通知では、事務所の掲示場への掲示などが定められています。改正後は、規則で定める方法で公示内容を不特定多数が閲覧できるようにし、掲示場への掲示または事務所の電子画面での閲覧も行います。
changes: 公示事項を規則で定める方法で不特定多数が閲覧できる状態に置く
掲示場への掲示または事務所の電子画面での閲覧を行う
措置開始から2週間後に通知が到達したものとみなす
who: 聴聞や弁明の機会の通知を公示で受ける人
why: 行政手続法の一部改正を踏まえ、公示事項をインターネットなどで閲覧できるようにするためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Publishes notices of hearings and other matters online too
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Sumida City Administrative Procedures Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, notices of hearings or opportunities to make a statement by public notice must be posted on bulletin boards at offices, among other methods. After the amendment, the details of the public notice will be made available for viewing by the general public using methods set out in rules. They will also be posted on bulletin boards or made viewable on electronic screens at offices.
changes: Make the matters to be publicly announced available for viewing by an unspecified number of people using methods set out in rules
Post them on bulletin boards or make them viewable on electronic screens at offices
Deem the notice to have been delivered two weeks after the measure begins
who: People who receive public notice of a hearing or an opportunity to make a statement
en.why: The ward says this is to make matters announced by public notice viewable on the internet and other channels, following a partial amendment to the Administrative Procedure Act.
